svg.title: A LiteX PCIe SoC with LitePCIe
svg.desc: A LiteX PCIe SoC. On the host: the LitePCIe kernel driver (litepcie.ko, one /dev/litepcieN per DMA channel, liteuart.ko for the console), liblitepcie, litepcie_util/litepcie_test, your application, and litex_server --pcie for the LiteX tools without the driver. In the FPGA: the PHY wrapping the vendor hard IP in the pcie clock domain, the endpoint (TLP layer, crossbar), the MMAP master mapping BAR0 to the SoC bus (CSRs, memories, every core), the DMA channels (reader and writer with scatter-gather descriptors, buffering, loopback, synchronizer) connected to the streams of your cores, the MSI interrupts; the SoC around it with an optional CPU, LiteDRAM, and the cores the design is about.

g.font-family: Calibri, Carlito, 'Liberation Sans', Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif
g.text: MMAP and DMA ioctls, MSI, zero-copy mmap
BAR0 through sysfs, no driver needed
lspci -vv: LnkSta 5 GT/s x4, BAR0, MSI
vendor hard IP, pcie clock domain
every core visible from the host
at the link rate, no CPU in the path
The host drives the FPGA: registers through BAR0, data through the DMAs
add_pcie(phy, ndmas): endpoint, MMAP bridge, DMAs, MSI, the driver and the tools; --driver generates build/<board>/driver/
